parameters.name: IncludeDeletedResources
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include deleted resources. Valid values:

- true

- false

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SearchExpression
parameters.description:
The search keyword. Resource Center filters and sorts the search results based on relevance.
If you do not specify a sorting parameter, resources that better match the keyword are displayed with higher priority.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcecenter search-resources --next-token eyJzZWFyY2hBZnRlcnMiOlsiMTAwMTU2Nzk4MTU1OSJd0000 --max-results 10 --filter '[{"MatchType":"Equals","Value":["过滤条件值。"],"Key":"RegionId"}]' --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --sort-criterion Order=ASC Key=CreateTime --search-expression keywords --include-deleted-resources true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcecenter SearchResources --region cn-hangzhou --Filter.1.MatchType Equals --NextToken eyJzZWFyY2hBZnRlcnMiOlsiMTAwMTU2Nzk4MTU1OSJd0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --SortCriterion.Order ASC --Filter.1.Value.1 '过滤条件值。' --IncludeDeletedResources true --MaxResults 10 --SortCriterion.Key CreateTime --SearchExpression keywords --Filter.1.Key RegionId --method POST --force
